name: XDK DirectSound (DSOUND)
_why: DirectSoundCreate waits for the AC'97 codec: the emulated APU with a ready codec, else a hang after the USB
start and no flip. Seen on: Fable 4D5300D1, Burnout 3 4541005B (XDK 5849).
XBA-106: also a runtime default (recomp_xdk_defaults.c). applies.imports (MmLockUnlockBufferPages,
MmGetPhysicalAddress, the APU interrupt through HalGetInterruptVector/KeConnectInterrupt): a first guess, to
check on the library triage (XBA-63); D3D and XPP connect interrupts too, hence all four.
